verdict.rationale: Salv documents a CSV data upload endpoint for historical persons and transactions, so bulk import exists. Nothing in the evidence describes tracking import job status, reporting per-row errors, or resuming after partial failure. The upsert-style partial-attribute update is only a building block a developer might use for idempotent retries, not import tracking or resume, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track bulk customer and transaction imports and resume after partial failure
